limits: This Node invocation consumes the saved independent NumPy audit; it does not rerun numerical computation or start Python/JAX.
The first-update audit uses recorded minibatch indices and independently derives gradients/momentum; it does not independently generate JAX random permutations.
The workflow records reload into a new handle in the same worker. A separate fresh-worker check requires its own evidence.
No typed AgentFootprint event tail or live control-dependency lookup was captured; native Lens absence warnings are retained.
Dataset content overlap diagnostics do not establish original source-row identity disjointness.
This proves the retained CPU example; it does not benchmark production, GPU, or distributed execution.
